query:
UPDATE chat_members
        SET last_read_message_id = GREATEST(COALESCE(last_read_message_id, 0), $3)
        WHERE chat_id = $1
          AND user_id = $2
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM messages WHERE id = $3 AND chat_id = $1
          )
        RETURNING last_read_message_id AS "last_read_message_id!"
